svg.text: Layers, the data flow between them, and where the API key lives
assistant · embeddings · documents · tests · admin · session · useLive
Word and PDF text is extracted in the browser; files never hit our server
Session in sessionStorage: each tab keeps its own role,
so two roles can run side by side. Theme in localStorage, shared.
classify · suggest · checklist · embed · compare · requirements · image · tests
GEMINI_API_KEY lives here, as an environment variable
Similarity search and the closure rule live in the database, in one place
a JSON schema is enforced via responseSchema
enum constrains the value set, so the model
cannot return free text or unexpected values
no waiting, moves to the next model
Why does the API key live in the Edge Function?
React code ships to the browser; anything written there is readable from devtools. Had the key been embedded in the frontend, every user
could take it and spend the quota. The Edge Function is a thin server layer in between: the key stays there and the browser never sees Gemini.
